assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production background for a 2D point-and-click Chinese mythology adventure game, NOT a UI mockup. Wide 16:9 1792x1008 cinematic painted scene. Camera is at human eye level in the ancient Phoenix sanctuary of Danxue, standing on an accessible stone terrace inside an open-sided volcanic cave. Beautiful hand-painted Chinese fantasy, ink-wash edges, refined detailed architecture, warm amber lava light, muted teal bronze, readable composition. The actual interactive objects must be large, physically grounded and built into the environment. LEFT SIDE: at x=22%,y=37% a large weathered rock wall relief carved into the wall itself, depicting a phoenix with its TWO WINGS lifted and the chest calm, shallow etched lines glowing subtly in firelight, NO rectangular plaque or sign. Below the relief at x=22%,y=71% a broad empty horizontal stone ledge illuminated by warm light; leave a flat place to rest a hand fan, but DO NOT PAINT any fan. RIGHT TWO THIRDS: a huge ancient bronze and basalt furnace platform is built into the rock at x=65%,y=60%. Its front face is almost frontal, has THREE large circular dark air mouths set directly into this same massive carved stone front wall, centered at x=45%,62%,79%, y=65%, each about 9% image width. They have aged bronze sculpted bird-feather rims, deep dark interiors, NO grates or shutters, NO circles drawn as interface. Leave these three mouths clearly separated and equally large. Above the furnace at x=65%,y=32% is an elaborate stone phoenix nest, glowing ember bed and a delicate phoenix feather silhouette in the fire, NOT a huge finished phoenix flying yet. A curving stone path on far right leads upward to an archway at x=91%,y=40%. Distant lava waterfalls and mountains give depth beyond the open cave, but the foreground relief and furnace are the main focus. Top 12% mostly dark cave ceiling, bottom 16% dark stone floor for game text overlay. All objects belong to one coherent scene with consistent perspective and contact shadows. No characters, no UI, no labels, no floating objects, no borders, no circles or arrows drawn over scenery, no text, no watermark.
